en.ascii: JoeRunner meets his friend T.T. outside the school.

en.html: The boy with black hair watches as JoeRunner walks out of a minivan with a canoe strapped to the top. The boy wears a T‐shirt reading 77 and shorts, has constant dropped eyebrows, and speaks in an all‐lowercase sans‐serif font.

en.ascii: JoeRunner walks up to the boy.
Hey, JoeRunner, you made it! And it only took, like, two decades!

fr.text: Hé, JoeRunner, tu es arrivé ! Et ça n’a pris que, genre, deux décennies !

en.text: Yeah, there was lots of traffic on North 1 today.
en.html: Yeah, there was lots of traffic on North 1 today.

fr.text: Ouais, il y avait beaucoup de trafic sur Nord 1 aujourd’hui.
fr.html: Ouais, il y avait beaucoup de trafic sur Nord 1 aujourd’hui.

en.ascii: The boy starts walking to the door.

en.text: T.T. / one heck of a guy
en.html: T.T. / one heck of a guy

Yeah, yeah, excuses, excuses.

Come on! We’re only gonna have time for six games of Hyper Galactic Battle Ducks III! Six!

fr.html:
Ouais, ouais, je veux pas tes excuses.

Allez ! Nous aurons seulement de temps pour six parties de Hyper Galactic Battle Ducks III ! Seulement six !
